F1y.fix: svpt := svpt + df for both players (on the raw row, before Stage 0's checks); every other count unchanged
F1y.reasons: Bad Gastein 2015 is one of the 30 events in the window (F1). Stosur d. Koukalova 6-1 6-0: Koukalova has 9 double faults against 6 second serves in play (svpt 21 - first_in 15), so B6 fails. That is impossible if serve points include double faults (a double fault is a lost second-serve point), and it is the window's convention at its most visible. On the raw counts only B6 fails. After svpt := svpt + df for both players every check B0-B9 passes, the definition test holds on both rows, points per game are normal, and the games identity fits exactly (Stosur 7 service games, 0 broken; Koukalova 6, 5 broken: 12-1 games = the score). The fix is the F1 fix that round 1 confirmed for the event's other rows. The 4th B6 failure, Nottingham QF Konjuh-Vickery, is not proposed and would still fail B9 after the fix.
